title: Bug: RateLimiter.allow_request() counts window boundaries wrongly and blocks legitimate traffic
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/rate_limiter.py`

The sliding-window limiter counts ALL timestamps ever recorded instead of only those within the window, so after the first burst every later request is denied forever. A regression introduced in v1.2.
### Expected
- at most `max_requests` within any `window_sec`
- old timestamps expire and no longer count
